description: ODC (data lot, phase 3): REFACTORING of the entity model over job:data-full-model (WfCovTask with FKs ProjectId/PriorityId and indexes; the mirror of tests/jobs/entity-refactor.json). (1) REPOINT a common attribute with a consumer: Title -> Subject (an aggregate with a filter created here is rewired; the source is deleted without force). (2) REPOINT a FK: PriorityId -> PriorityId2; each FK has an AutoIndex and the replace drags the old one to the new one: the proven path is to delete the old AutoIndex and only then the old FK. (3) CHANGE THE TYPE of a FK: with a DefaultValue the kernel refuses; clearing the DefaultValue first lets the change through (it executes; it does not prove migration). (4) RENAME an index, change Unique and REORDER the attributes of an index (PLATFORM DIFFERENCE: in ODC IEntityIndex.IndexAttributes is a sequence and `move EntityIndex:X/<Atributo>` is accepted; in O11 it is refused, tests/jobs-negative/move-index-attribute.json). (5) DELETE the entity: without force it is refused because of the anonymous record even without author consumers; with force it is an OBSERVED BEHAVIOR with unproven integrity (the IAttribute and the IAnonymousStructure `WfCovScratch Record` are left over, which the Verify does not flag). None of this proves a safe migration of a published database.

expectedMessages.why: ODC: an app (CrossDevice) does not expose a public server action (the live Studio errors); the action stays private and without a consumer in this proof job
